tr.td: Escalation (RCP NEWS2): 0–4 low risk — routine monitoring · 3 in any single parameter — registered nurse review · 5–6 medium risk — urgent review by a clinician competent in acute illness · 7+ high risk — emergency response. The ONC_NEWS2_Logic CQL library computes the score and the news2-escalation PlanDefinition encodes this protocol; this form does not replace clinical judgement.
